compiled_state.title: [brainstorm/cross-epic-scan]: orchestrator performs setup (load 122 epics, batch, build JSON) -> orchestrator context bloat and dispatch-boundary violation
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** feb530e2742c8b4cb59635b0fc86412b2c2ab05e
* **skill:** /dso:brainstorm Step 2.25 (Cross-Epic Interaction Scan)
* **prompt:** plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/prompts/cross-epic-scan.md
* **agent:** plugins/dso/agents/cross-epic-interaction-classifier.md (haiku)
* **session_context:** Brainstorm of epic 4100-95a4-07ce-41ab (sue-tribe-skid); 122 open/in_progress candidate epics in this repo

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

The /brainstorm workflow's HARD-GATE on Step 2.25 (cross-epic-scan.md) requires that cross-epic interaction scanning use sub-agents and explicitly forbids the orchestrator from substituting inline triage. The user-stated principle: the orchestrator must not be the entity performing the scan itself. By extension, the setup work that feeds the scan (loading every candidate epic's full description into context, building the new_epic JSON payload from session decisions, partitioning into batches) should also be sub-agent work — not orchestrator work — so that the orchestrator does not absorb 122 epic descriptions worth of context (~150KB+ in this case) and so that the scan's input preparation is encapsulated end-to-end inside a delegated unit.

#### Actual Behavior

cross-epic-scan.md Steps 2.25a through 2.25d are written as orchestrator-side actions:

* Step 2.25a (Fetch Open Epics) — orchestrator runs ticket list and filters
* Step 2.25b (Load Epic Details) — orchestrator runs ticket show on every candidate (122 calls in this session) and parses approach + success_criteria from each description
* Step 2.25c (Batch into Groups of 20) — orchestrator partitions candidates
* Step 2.25d (Usage-Aware Throttle Check) — orchestrator runs pre-check
* Step 2.25e (Dispatch Classifier per Batch) — first step that actually delegates

In the current session, executing Step 2.25b would have loaded 122 ticket show outputs into orchestrator context. As a workaround the orchestrator instead loaded a 1500-character description excerpt per epic into a single 152KB tmp file via one jq call — but the orchestrator still owns the entire setup pipeline (load, normalize, batch, build new_epic payload, dispatch, merge signals, route by severity). Only the per-batch classify call is delegated. The cited HARD-GATE in SKILL.md says "DISPATCH the dso:cross-epic-interaction-classifier haiku sub-agent ... Do NOT perform inline triage" but is silent on the setup pipeline that wraps the dispatch — so an orchestrator following the prompt literally still ends up performing substantial scan work itself.

### 3. Action History

1. Reached Step 2.25 in /dso:brainstorm of epic 4100-95a4-07ce-41ab.
2. Counted 122 open candidate epics via .claude/scripts/dso ticket list --type=epic | jq filter (orchestrator action).
3. Built /tmp/cross-epic-candidates-XXX.json with id/alias/title/desc[:1500] for all 122 epics (orchestrator action — already 152KB into orchestrator output).
4. Split into 7 batch files via Bash (orchestrator action).
5. Hand-authored /tmp/cross-epic-new-epic.json containing the new_epic payload distilled from the Phase 1/2 dialogue (orchestrator action — synthesis of session state into classifier input).
6. About to dispatch 7 parallel haiku classifier Agent calls — at which point the user paused execution to file this bug.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* /dso:brainstorm Step 2.25 (Cross-Epic Interaction Scan)
* prompts/cross-epic-scan.md (Steps 2.25a–2.25g)
* agents/cross-epic-interaction-classifier.md (haiku) — currently the only delegated unit

### 6. Logs

User message at pause point: 'Create a bug for the orchestrator performing cross-epic interaction scan itself. The /brainstorm workflow REQUIRES that this use sub-agents.'

### Suggested fix sketch (advisory, not part of bug)

Wrap Steps 2.25a–2.25g into a single dispatch sub-agent (e.g., dso:cross-epic-scan-coordinator) that owns: fetching open epics, loading their details, batching, dispatching N classifier sub-agents (or running classification serially inside itself with the haiku model), merging signals, and routing by severity. The orchestrator's responsibility collapses to one Agent call that returns the merged interaction_signals array. This isolates ~150KB+ of epic-content scanning work from the brainstorm orchestrator's working context and makes Step 2.25 actually live inside a sub-agent boundary, not just nominally cross it at the per-batch dispatch step.

comments.body: Triage 2026-05-16: scope is architectural — fix requires wrapping brainstorm Steps 2.25a–2.25g into a new dso:cross-epic-scan-coordinator sub-agent (ticket's own suggested-fix sketch). Beyond single-bug-fix scope. Recommend escalating to /dso:brainstorm to scope an epic for the coordinator agent + the contract changes in cross-epic-scan.md.
